top_signals.title: Japanese Stocks Slide as Bond Market Anxiety Hits AI Sentiment
top_signals.summary: Japan’s Nikkei Stock Average slumped for a second day, weighed down by chip-related stocks as anxiety over surging bond yields sapped risk appetite from the AI trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
